label: Key detect
description: Detect source key color.

label: Chroma mask
description: HSV green-screen alpha mask.

label: Distance mask
description: Legacy RGB distance alpha mask.

label: Pixel mask
description: Hard alpha mask for pixel art.

label: Rembg mask
description: Optional AI mask fused with chroma mask.

label: Despill
description: Neutralize green edge spill.

label: Outline
description: Compose dark outline around alpha edge.

label: Alpha cleanup
description: Remove tiny alpha islands and optional pinholes before frame detection.

label: Frame detect
description: Find animation frame components.

label: Semantic input
description: Build the RGB frame variant used by Qwen3 and the semantic mask model.

label: Semantic propose
description: Ask local VLM for part specs when semantic mode is enabled.

label: Frame interpolate 2x
description: Insert Practical-RIFE midpoint frames after Qwen3 interpretation and before semantic grounding/SAM3.

label: Semantic grounding
description: Transform Qwen grounding hints into explicit SAM3 bbox and point edits.

label: Part segment track
description: Send semantic RGB frame crops to the semantic service.

label: Part mask validate
description: Clip semantic masks to base alpha and reject invalid part masks.

label: Part stabilize
description: Apply mobility-aware local temporal repair for semantic parts.

label: Geometry stabilize
description: Align frames by alpha centroid and bottom anchor to reduce sprite wobble.

label: Sheet build
description: Normalize frames into output sheet.

label: Flow deflicker
description: Warp neighboring frames with optical flow and blend only consistent pixels.

label: Temporal deflicker
description: Blend stable pixels toward their temporal median to reduce AI shimmer.

label: Edge extrude
description: Copy edge RGB into transparent padding to prevent texture bleed.

label: Upscale
description: Optional nearest/AuraSR upscale.

label: Metrics
description: Evaluate output quality metrics.
